system.description:
Effect: Until you use a one-hour or longer recovery, you can move objects and creatures within short range using your mind. Choose whether you want to use this ability with strength or finesse. Strength: You attempt to pull, push, or lift a target and move them up to a short distance. The target must be no larger than yourself and no heavier than your weight. Make an Intellect attack against the target. If you succeed, you move the target a short distance in any direction, either gently or with force. If they hit something, at your discretion they take 4 damage from the impact. If you use a level of Effort on the attack specifically for this cypher, the successful attack also knocks them prone. Finesse: You can manipulate an object or creature with finesse for one round as if you were touching it directly. For example, you could type on a keyboard, turn a doorknob and open a door, yank something from a creature’s grasp, or lift something out of a creature’s pocket. Using telekinesis this way requires a roll only if performing the task directly would require one. The cypher ends after you have used the telekinesis six times.

Genre Items: ring of telekinesis (fantasy); personal tractor beam (sci-fi)
